news.title: Work on the Next Update Has Already Started!
news.description: Development on the next update is already underway. Follow our Patreon and Discord to stay up to date, see previews, and keep track of upcoming content for Lust Family.

news.title: A New Family Morning Event
news.description: Sunday morning gets a lot more fun with a new family event featuring Twister. Expect playful moments, new interactions, and a scene that adds more life to the house.

news.title: Becca Arrives in Extra Girls
news.description: Becca is now part of the Extra Girls content. A beautiful married woman, new events, tension, intrigue, and spicy moments make her one of the highlights of the current update.

news.title: Help Decide the Next Main Girl Focus!
news.description: Want more events for your favorite girl? Now is your chance to help decide who will receive the biggest focus in the next update. Your vote can influence the direction of upcoming content.

news.title: Lust Family v0.2.0 Is Here!
news.description: Version 0.2.0 brings new university events, improvements to the economy, new discoveries, and the arrival of Becca in Extra Girls. This update expands the game with more content and new possibilities.
